dateline: Seoul, South Korea — BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Las Vegas closes May 31; Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG and BTS × Oreo hotteok cookies launch June 1; ARMY presale for Asia & Australia legs opens June 2; Busan anniversary shows June 12–13
heroHeadline: Day 4,735: BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Las Vegas Closes; Nike × BTS & BTS × Oreo Launch June 1 — Eyes on Busan Anniversary Shows June 12–13
heroSubtitle: May 31, 2026 is Day 4,735 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Today marks the final day of 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Las Vegas' — the 11-day citywide fan experience running May 21–31 — as BTS members travel back to South Korea following their historic four-night Allegiant Stadium residency (~260,000 fans). The Samsung Galaxy × BTS fan activation at Allegiant Stadium also wraps today. The Billboard chart dated May 30 confirmed 'SWIM' at No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) for a seventh time in 2026 (three consecutive weeks), while Drake's 'Janice STFU' debuted at No. 1 on the Global 200, displacing 'SWIM' to No. 10; all 13 ARIRANG vocal tracks remain on global charts for a ninth consecutive week. 'SWIM' holds No. 55 on the Hot 100 in its 10th consecutive charting week — an all-time K-pop record. On June 1, Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG customization opens in 20+ cities, and BTS × Oreo hotteok-flavored cookies go on sale in 80+ countries. The ARMY membership presale for the Asia and Australia legs of the ARIRANG World Tour opens June 2 at btsworldtourofficial.com (general on-sale June 4–5); shows run November 2026–March 2027 across Kaohsiung, Bangkok, Singapore, Jakarta, Melbourne, Sydney, and Bulacan. BTS's next performances are Busan Asiad Main Stadium on June 12–13 — their 13th debut anniversary — with a global cinema live viewing on June 13 via Trafalgar Releasing. 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' citywide experience opens June 5.
